title: Certifying Repeatable Entry-Replay Witnesses for COBOL-to-Java Migration
abstract: arXiv:2610.27272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Producing synthetic data for comparison testing a migrated COBOL application is a major challenge that agentic migrations face today. Our prior paper, the Agentic Method for Deterministic Validation of Legacy Code Migration, presents a deterministic oracle to facilitate such migrations, the Locksmith Loop. We now propose a novel method for achieving high branch and paragraph coverage through generated synthetic end-to-end test cases, by means of entry-replay test-case certification by observing the code execution trace on a surrogate COBOL program that mocks external interactions via a chronological external-operation tape. We applied our method to a very large COBOL program with 33,429 lines of code to generate 849 synthetic end-to-end test cases covering 2,973/3,806 source branches (78.1%) and 989/1,033 main-AST paragraphs (95.7%). translated_title: 为COBOL到Java迁移认证可重复的进入-回放见证
translated_abstract: 为迁移后的COBOL应用程序生成合成数据以进行比较测试，是当今智能体迁移面临的一项重大挑战。我们之前的论文《遗留代码迁移确定性验证的智能体方法》提出了一种促进此类迁移的确定性判定基准——Locksmith Loop。我们现在提出一种新颖的方法，通过在代理COBOL程序上观察代码执行轨迹，并利用按时间顺序记录外部交互的外部操作带，实现进入-回放测试用例的认证，从而借助生成的合成端到端测试用例实现高分支覆盖率和段落覆盖率。我们将该方法应用于一个拥有33,429行代码的超大型COBOL程序，生成了849个合成端到端测试用例，覆盖了2,973/3,806个源代码分支（78.1%）和989/1,033个主AST段落（95.7%）。利用Locksmith Loop的投影一致性验证，生成的Java代码与COBOL源代码相匹配……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于按时间顺序外部操作带的进入-回放测试用例认证方法，在模拟外部交互的代理COBOL程序上生成合成端到端测试用例，使一个33,429行的大型COBOL程序达到78.1%的分支覆盖率和95.7%的段落覆盖率，从而支持COBOL到Java迁移的确定性验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes entry-replay test-case certification using a chronological external-operation tape to mock external interactions on a surrogate COBOL program, generating synthetic end-to-end tests that achieve 78.1% branch and 95.7% paragraph coverage on a 33,429-line COBOL program to enable deterministic COBOL-to-Java migration validation.
